content.short: ScamSniffer identifies scam websites and malicious transactions in real time.
content.description: ScamSniffer addresses phishing in Web3 to safeguard end users from malicious links. NFT marketplaces and NFT data platforms can integrate ScamSniffer API to identify malicious URLs in real time, helping to keep listings and data safe before exposure. End users can install the Chrome extension to spot risky URLs as they visit sites, and Discord communities can deploy the ScamSniffer bot to identify malicious URLs within chats, supporting safer interactions across Web3 ecosystems.
